findings.sentence: TechStartups reported on 2025-06-10 that Linear has raised an $82 million Series C, as the company said. This is consistent with Crustdata's indexed record (Crunchbase-derived), which lists a Series C of $82,000,000 on 2025-06-10.
findings.limitation: The packet holds a press report, not Linear's own post; the report is not independent of the company's announcement, and Crustdata's record is not independent confirmation.

findings.sentence: TechStartups reports that Accel led Linear's $82 million Series C, and the CEO's blog post quoted in the same article says the round was led by Accel. Crustdata's indexed record (Crunchbase-derived) also lists Accel as the Series C lead.
findings.limitation: The CEO quote and the report are one announcement chain, not two independent sources.

findings.sentence: CEO Karri Saarinen's blog post, as quoted by TechStartups, says Linear raised an $82M Series C at a $1.25B valuation and that the round includes both primary and secondary funding. Crustdata's indexed record (Crunchbase-derived) separately lists a secondary-market entry on 2025-06-10 with no amount recorded.
findings.limitation: No source gives the split between primary and secondary funding, so the share of the $82M that went to the company is unknown; the $1.25B valuation is not capital.
findings.question: How much of the $82M Series C was new primary capital to Linear, and how much was secondary sales by existing holders?

findings.sentence: TechStartups, reporting Linear's $82 million Series C, quotes Karri Saarinen as CEO.
findings.limitation: Karri Saarinen is not among the founders in Crustdata's people record for this run, so his title has no graph join here; the title comes from the press report only.

findings.sentence: Tracxn's page (updated 2026-10-13) says Linear has raised a total of $134M over 4 funding rounds, which lines up with the seed, Series A, Series B and Series C entries in Crustdata's indexed record (Crunchbase-derived). Crustdata's total_investment_usd of $233,200,000 includes secondary sales, among them a $99,000,000 secondary-market entry on 2026-08-26, so it is not capital raised.
findings.limitation: The Series C itself includes secondary funding (per the CEO's quoted post), so neither total is a measure of primary capital; Tracxn is an aggregator, not a primary source.
